title: Procedure Carve-Out on Self-Pay Observation Stays, Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
Separately billed procedure lines on a self-pay Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) observation account (CT, revenue code 0350, and echocardiography, revenue code 0480), whose time is not observation time, earn the procedure carve-out.

**Clause.** Two or more such lines add a flat 120.00 USD to the observation-rate discount; exactly one adds a flat 60.00; none adds nothing.

| CT (0350) and echocardiography (0480) lines on the account | Flat amount added |
|---|---|
| two or more | 120.00 |
| exactly one | 60.00 |
| none | nothing |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical accounts)

- One CT line and one echocardiography line are two lines: 120.00.
- Three CT lines: 120.00, the same as two.
- One echocardiography line only: 60.00.
- Laboratory and drug lines are not procedure lines for this purpose.
